name: guardian naga
lore:
Imagine stumbling upon an ancient temple, the air thick with the scent of sweet blossoms, an unexpected fragrance amidst the crumbling stone. As you venture deeper, a low, melodic hum vibrates through the chamber, growing stronger with each step. Then, you see it: a colossal serpent, scales shimmering with greenish-gold, a silvery pattern tracing its spine. Its eyes, pools of molten gold, fix upon you with unnerving intelligence. This is no ordinary beast, but a guardian naga, an immortal being of immense power and wisdom. 

Guardian nagas are the keepers of forgotten lore and protectors of potent artifacts. They stand as vigilant sentinels against those who would seek to abuse magic for their own nefarious purposes. Approach with caution, for while their hearts are generally aligned with good, they are fiercely protective of their charges and will not hesitate to unleash their formidable spellcasting abilities and venomous strikes upon any perceived threat. Respect, diplomacy, and a clear demonstration of noble intent are your only hope of earning their favor and passing unscathed.
